== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2769]] is assessed at 88% (probable). The 1820 Giles and 1840 Lauderdale census accounts establish Robert’s household chronology; Priscilla,28, is named with Robert in 1850 and fits the 1840 female15–19 bracket. Named co-residence makes daughter a strong inference, though 1850 has no relationship column.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

=== Current research ===

Priscilla was probably a daughter of Robert Glasgow-2769. In 1840 Robert's household contained one female aged 15–19, exactly compatible with Priscilla's estimated 1822 birth. In 1850 Priscilla Glascoe, aged 28 and born in Tennessee, was named in Robert Glaseoe's Giles County household. The 1850 census had no relationship column, so the daughter identification is a strong inference, not an explicitly stated relationship.

No marriage or later occurrence has been identified. The available pre-1865 Giles County marriage compilation contains no Priscilla Glasgow/Glasco entry.
